discription: A basic detuned saw wave pad sound with a smooth ADSR envelope, using two slightly detuned saw oscillators for a fuller sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.2, decay=0.8, sustain=0.7, release=1.5, cutoff=4000;var sig, env;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq * [0.998, 1.002]);sig = sig.mean;sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
